name: AGENT_OUTCOME_SCORER_FANOUT_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: AGENT_OUTCOME_SCORER_FANOUT_20261107 — LQ-20261107-125. match_and_score joined each recommendation
to every closed trade on its symbol in a 90-day window, in every account, and keyed 'already scored' on
(war_id, trade_id), so every trade_closed reload queued it again. A recommendation now gets at most one
outcome: its named account only (aliases resolved), a trade held at the recommendation first, the nearest
otherwise; an unknown account that spans two accounts is held back, not guessed. Listing it schedules nothing.
